content:
Lina H: Quick design thread: I'm worried users misinterpret "suppressed" vs "muted" in the alert preview. support tickets show engineers disabling channels thinking alerts were turned off.
Marco R: Oof. good catch. we use suppressed (policy-level, timeboxed) and muted (UI-level, temporary snooze). wording is too similar.
Devon S: Could we group channels into clusters in the preview: Active -> Suppressed -> Muted? A small header per group would make states explicit.
Yuki N: Grouping is nice but be careful with SR: screenreaders will announce group headings. we should use <h3> semantics or role="group" + aria-label.
Lina H: Proposed copy for group headers: "Sending now", "Suppressed (until 3:15pm) — rule: weekend-window", "Muted (you)", so ownership and timeframe are clear.
Marco R: Also propose a subtle color + pattern for suppressed rows rather than only greying them out; that helps color-deficient users. include an icon with aria-hidden and sr-only text describing state.
Devon S: UX micro-interaction: hovering a suppressed channel shows who suppressed it and why (click to expand). keyboard: focus should reveal details with Enter.
Yuki N: For SR copy, avoid ambiguous verbs like "snooze" without context. use full phrases: "You muted notifications for this channel until 4:00pm". keep it short.
Lina H: Another idea: add a tiny timeline scrubber at the top of preview: show preview state at a point in time (now vs 1h ago vs at alert creation). customers want to simulate historical behavior.
Marco R: Timeline scrubber sounds powerful but might be heavy. maybe a simpler "View as of" dropdown: Now / At alert trigger time / Custom.
Devon S: If we add timeline, ensure the copy explains what changes: e.g., "At trigger time, channel X was active; now it's muted".
ux-bot: Note: feature request logged: https://go/redwood/ux/issue/4523 (timeline-preview + state-grouping).
Yuki N: Accessibility checklist: group headings, aria-live summary of group counts like "2 channels sending, 1 suppressed, 1 muted", and avoid using only color to convey state. test with VoiceOver & NVDA.
Lina H: Draft aria-live sentence: "This alert will notify PagerDuty and Slack. Suppressed: Ops-email until 15:12 by rule 'weekday-quiet'. Muted: mobile-alerts by you until 16:00."
Marco R: Copy tweak: replace "by you" with the actor's display name when available. more informative.
Devon S: Small API ask: include actor and reason for suppression/mute in preview payload and a boolean "historical_state" flag for timeline mode. we can fallback to best-effort.
Lina H: I'll make two mocks: compact grouped list and expanded timeline view. posting images soon for quick thumbs. tagging @Yuki N for a11y sign-off when ready. :eyes:
